notes.title: Slender Threads Launches February 7th!
notes.notes:
Something dark has been winding for years...
As the darkest night approaches, shadows grow longer and mystery weaves tighter, prepare yourself for the news everyone has been waiting for.

We’re ready to unveil our best-kept secret. A date that will seal many fates:
[b]February 7th, 2025[/b] – The day Slender Threads sees the light. The day darkness takes control.

We know it takes more than words to feed the spirit, so watch this new trailer and get ready to dive back into the unknown as Slender Threads embrace you.

[previewyoutube=Sg-1JWW5m5E;full]https://youtu.be/Sg-1JWW5m5E[/previewyoutube]
And for those who haven’t joined the wait yet, what are you waiting for? Come join the 40,000 souls already waiting in the dark...👻

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1116480/Slender_Threads/

Mark your calendars and get ready to discover everything you’ve been dying to know!

Dare to follow the Slender Threads?

notes.title: Nobodies: After Death is coming to Steam on April 20th.
notes.notes:
Were you Missing Agent 1080's extravagances? We are happy to share that he'll soon be Lonely no more! 

Nobodies: After Death is coming to Steam on April 20th. Wishlist Now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1816950/Nobodies_After_Death/

Join him on this new adventure featuring:
[list]
[*] 13 new missions
[*] Localization into 13 languages
[*] Full English audio.
[*] 30 crazy achievements to pursue.
[/list]
